# Wilhelmina Novak

> **Withering Eye** des Neuf Yeux — tutrice **Magie** de Wolfgang. Originaire **Altdorf**. Cultiste Tzeentch active. **Left Reikguard for Altdorf** — étudie University Altdorf Schulergegend district. Wall painting **eight winds of magic arranged as a wheel** dans room Reikguard.

- **Culte secret** : **Withering Eye** (Neuf Yeux cell Tzeentch).

## Source
- **EiR Intro l.122-131** liste 9 Yeux.
- **EiR ch.4 l.280-281** room Reikguard : *« Wilhelmina Novak left for Altdorf recently. Her room is spotless and the many bookshelves here are bare. A colourful mural depicting the eight winds of magic arranged as a wheel is painted on one wall »*.
- **EiR ch.6 l.42** : *« Wilhelmina Novak (of the Withering Eye), Wulfrum Ahlquist (of the Public Eye), and Gislind Ursin (of the Hollow Eye) are all in Altdorf at this time, preparing lessons for the Prince Héritier at the University of Altdorf »*. Mêmes robes grises que collègues Reikguard. Sociallly awkward.
- **EiR ch.13** climax — présente Volkshalle si vivante.
